The '''[[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system's]] criminal organization''', called simply the '''Organization''' by those within it, was put together by [[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] when he arrived in the system. Soon, he convinced the [[Smugglers' Confederation]] to work for him, and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] remained one of the principal concerns of the Organization, as well as [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], loansharking and, from [[78 BBY]], [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. However, local [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] always escaped the control of the Organization.<ref name="LFC">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

In [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]], Riboga lost control of the Organization in a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game with his [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]], a strange [[Alien/Legends|alien]] named [[Nirama]]. Riboga had been under the impression that the criminal enterprises within the Cularin system had become unprofitable&mdash;an impression devised by Nirama&mdash;so he took the loss well, and the Organization passed into Nirama's hands without violence.<ref name="LFC" />

[[File:Markus_and_friends.jpg|250px|thumb|Several members of Nirama's Organization conversing with their leader]]

One of the first things that Nirama changed was to abolish the slave trade. This move was not universally approved of, as slavery had been quite lucrative.<ref name="LFC" /> In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], a conspiracy calling themselves [[the Cell]] came together with the intent of deposing of Nirama and reinstating the slave trade.<ref name="TW">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: TopWorld}}</ref> With the help of a group of spies, Nirama was able to root out the Cell before they could cause too much damage.<ref name="MW">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: MidWorld}}</ref><ref name="UW">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: UnderWorld}}</ref>

The Organization's primary center of operation was a base built on the [[Nirama's public asteroid|largest asteroid]] within the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. Several other asteroids in the belt also held bases used by the Organization.<ref name="LFC" />
